name: EntropicMem
description: EntropicMem gives agents durable memory on this computer: SQLite facts with full-text search, a Markdown vault, entities and relations, a timeline, and review tools. The MCP server runs locally over stdio and makes no network calls. Install the package first with `pipx install entropicmem` (or `pip install entropicmem`), then connect; the server creates a new v3 store under ~/.entropicmem on first use. An existing store is served as it is and is never migrated automatically.

prompts.text: What do you remember about the decisions we made on this project?
Remember that this project deploys from the release branch, never from main.
Show me what happened in this project over the last two weeks.

apps.name: EntropicMem
apps.description: Local memory search, writes, corrections and history over the EntropicMem MCP stdio server. No key and no network call.
